achievements.label: First Light
achievements.description: Keep the light through your first night.

achievements.label: Quiet Night
achievements.description: End a night with no trouble at all: no incident, no damage, no ship turned back.

achievements.label: Fog Bank
achievements.description: Bring every ship through a night of long fog.

achievements.label: Storm Warden
achievements.description: Come through a storm with every part of the station above half.

achievements.label: Tidy
achievements.description: Repair every part of the station in a single day.

achievements.label: Frugal
achievements.description: Finish a season with the oil never below 20.

achievements.label: Year at the Rock
achievements.description: Complete a year.

achievements.label: Wound Tight
achievements.description: Keep the clockwork turning for seven nights in a row.

achievements.label: Fog Bell
achievements.description: Build the fog bell.

achievements.label: Nothing Happened
achievements.description: End a night with nothing in the log at all.

achievements.label: Keeper for Life
achievements.description: Keep the light on after the first year.

achievements.label: Reading by Lamplight
achievements.description: Read five letters.

achievements.label: The Whole Cast
achievements.description: Meet all ten of the people who write to the light.

achievements.label: A Good Neighbour
achievements.description: Receive ten gifts.

achievements.label: Bravery is Optional
achievements.description: Keep the light for a whole year with Eerie details switched off.

achievements.label: Second Light
achievements.description: Find out who kept the second light on the water.

achievements.label: Square to the Floor
achievements.description: Find out why the chair kept turning.

achievements.label: The Drummer
achievements.description: Find out who was knocking at the cistern.

achievements.label: Two Cups
achievements.description: Find out who left the second cup.

achievements.label: Return to Sender
achievements.description: Find out who wrote the unsigned letters.

achievements.label: Twelve Windows
achievements.description: Find out about the ship that is not on any chart.
